stemMarkdown: The average age of a team of 11 members is 34 years. If the captain is 49 years old, what is the average age (in years) of the remaining members? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total age $= 11 \times 34 = 374$. Excluding the captain leaves $374 - 49 = 325$ years across $10$ members, so the average is $\dfrac{325}{10} = 32.5$.
